title: 第6章 哦师尊你穿书的啊第7章 剧情
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 入夜，月光如水，静静洒落在观世宗的山间。
赵归涯的洞府内，暖黄的阵法光芒映照着他那张俊美得近乎妖异的面容。
此时的赵归涯坐在石桌旁打着哈切，并百无聊赖的…………嗑着瓜子。
奇了怪了，算算时间她应该快来了呀，怎么一点动静都没有，他叫花鸡都快熟了。
这时，洞府外阵法传来波动，赵归涯眼睛一亮，来了！
随即打了个响指，四周缓缓散起迷雾，不消片刻洞府内部便被迷雾覆盖，赵归涯也消失在迷雾之中。
“小未，你在吗？”
楚安芷手里端着一个蛋糕在洞府外叫了一声里面并没回应，她微微皱了皱眉。
感受着里面的气息，发现楚未倒在冰冷石床上一动不动吓了一跳，便匆匆抬步往里走。
哎呀，不会出事了吧。
可她一踏进洞府，便被迷雾迷了眼睛，待迷雾散开，入眼可见竟是一片断壁残垣，她手中的蛋糕也不见了，取而代之的是一把链剑，正是楚安芷的本命剑——青霜。
而她对面站着一位黑袍男子。
男子原是背对着她，似是感受到有人到来，他缓缓抬头，露出了一张被毁灼烧了半张脸的面容，一双冷漠的琥珀色眼眸冷冷看着她。
“师尊，”
男子缓缓向楚安芷走来，幽幽开口，“前些年把我当炉鼎吸收了我所有修为，可是把我榨干了呢～，怎样用这可还满意。”
楚安芷瞳孔骤缩，手中的青霜剑发出嗡鸣。
眼前的黑袍男子虽然半张脸被毁，但那唇下一点红痣和琥珀色的眼眸，分明就是……
已经黑化的楚未！
楚安芷缓缓后退，余光扫视四周，越看越心惊。
这环境，这语气，这不就是原书中楚未黑化后杀上观世宗的场景吗！
就在这时，‘楚未’突然暴起，掌风直朝她的面门而来。
楚安芷本能地抬剑格挡。
“我不是！”
楚安芷正想说我不是她。
就看见‘楚未’突然收起杀气，离她半米站定，双手抱胸噗呲一笑。
楚安芷就觉眼前一白。
待眼前的白光散去，楚安芷发现自己站在一间雅致的石洞内。
手上的青霜剑也变回了蛋糕。
洞内陈设简单却处处透着温馨，桌上放着半杯未喝完的灵茶和瓜子，桌边还吊着一个吊床。
哇哦，这个吊床看起来好好看。
等等不对，为什么这里会有吊床啊喂？
content_en:
At night, the moonlight is like water, quietly falling on the mountains of Guanshizong.
In Zhao Guiya's cave, the warm yellow light of the formation reflected his handsome, almost eerie face.
At this time, Zhao Guiya was sitting at the stone table, playing Haqie, and bored......eating melon seeds.
It's strange. Calculating the time, she should be here soon, but there is no movement at all. His chicken is almost ready.
At this time, there was a fluctuation in the formation outside the cave, and Zhao Guiya's eyes lit up, here he comes!
Then he snapped his fingers, and the fog slowly dispersed around him. Within a moment, the interior of the cave was covered in fog, and Zhao Guiya also disappeared into the fog.
"Xiaowei, are you there?"
Holding a cake in her hand, Chu Anzhi called out outside the cave but there was no response. She frowned slightly.
Feeling the breath inside, he was startled when he found Chu Wei lying motionless on the cold stone bed, and hurriedly walked inside.
Oh, nothing will happen.
But as soon as she stepped into the cave, she was blinded by the fog. When the fog cleared, she could see the ruins of the wall. The cake in her hand also disappeared, replaced by a chain sword, which was Chu Anzhi's natal sword - Qingshuang.
Opposite her stood a man in black robes.
The man's back was turned to her, as if he felt someone coming, he slowly raised his head, revealing a face with half of his face destroyed and burned, and a pair of cold amber eyes looking at her coldly.
"Master,"
The man slowly walked towards Chu Anzhi and said quietly, "In the past few years, he used me as a cauldron to absorb all my cultivation, but it drained me dry~, no matter how I use it, I am still satisfied."
Chu Anzhi's pupils shrank suddenly, and the Qingshuang sword in her hand buzzed.
Although half of the face of the man in black robe in front of me was destroyed, the red mole under his lip and the amber eyes were clearly...
Chu Wei has turned black!
Chu Anzhi slowly backed away and glanced around with her peripheral vision, becoming more and more frightened as she looked around.
This environment, this tone, isn't this the scene in the original book where Chu Wei turns evil and kills Shang Guan Shizong!
At this moment, 'Chu Wei' suddenly burst into flames, and the wind from his palm came straight towards her face.
Chu Anzhi instinctively raised her sword to block.
"I'm not!"
Chu Anzhi was about to say that I am not her.
Then she saw 'Chu Wei' suddenly put away his murderous aura, stood half a meter away from her, crossed his arms and smiled.
Chu Anzhi felt her eyes turn white.
When the white light in front of her eyes dissipated, Chu Anzhi found herself standing in an elegant stone cave.
The green frost sword in his hand also turned back into a cake.
The furnishings in the cave are simple but full of warmth. There is a half-drunk cup of spiritual tea and melon seeds on the table, and there is a hammock hanging next to the table.
Wow, this hammock looks great.
Wait, no, why are there hammocks here?
